outcome: admission to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 100 pregnant women with single pregnancy.
finding: The study concluded that there was no significant association between the presence of a nuchal cord and mode of delivery, APGAR score of the newborn, or admission to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit.
mod_finding: The study found no significant impact of nuchal cord on the mode of delivery.
